after.hourglass/gaps.py:
# owner: platform
"""Finding the stretches of opening hours that nobody covers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.parsing import format_span
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans


def _holes(spans: List[Span], opening: Span) -> List[Span]:
    edges = [opening.start]
    for span in spans:
        edges += [span.start, span.end]
    edges.append(opening.end)
    pairs = zip(edges[::2], edges[1::2])
    return [Span(left, right) for left, right in pairs if left < right]


# ---
def gap_labels(worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label per uncovered stretch, such as: gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)."""
    spans = merge_spans(worked)
    if any(span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end for span in spans):
        raise ValueError("worked span falls outside opening hours")
    return [f"gap {format_span(hole)} ({hole.minutes} min)" for hole in _holes(spans, opening)]
